% ss_tryit_good.tex — the full faded-scaffolding shape against ss_tryit.json:
% two \skillheading sections, each formulabox -> examplebox -> tryitbox, the
% try-it re-parameterizing its example (same skeleton, new givens) with the
% verified answer printed inside the box via \rotatebox{180}. Must PASS
% pairing, role agreement, and per-box value binding.
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath, mdframed, xcolor, graphicx}
\newmdenv{formulabox}
\newmdenv{examplebox}
\newmdenv{tryitbox}
\newcommand{\ans}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}
\newcommand{\skillheading}[1]{\section*{#1}}
\begin{document}

\skillheading{Finding a side with sine}

\begin{formulabox}
$\sin A = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$
\end{formulabox}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} $A = 40^\circ$, $c = 10$. Find $a$.\\
$a = 10\sin 40^\circ \approx \ans{6.43}$
\end{examplebox}

\begin{tryitbox}
\textbf{Try it:} $A = 35^\circ$, $c = 8$. Find $a$.\\
\rotatebox{180}{\footnotesize check: $\ans{4.59}$}
\end{tryitbox}

\skillheading{Pythagorean theorem}

\begin{formulabox}
$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$
\end{formulabox}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} legs $7$ and $24$. Find $c$.\\
$c = \sqrt{7^2 + 24^2} = \ans{25}$
\end{examplebox}

\begin{tryitbox}
\textbf{Try it:} legs $9$ and $12$. Find $c$.\\
\rotatebox{180}{\footnotesize check: $\ans{15}$}
\end{tryitbox}

\end{document}
